mapper.sql: id, user_id, type, content, read_flag, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_flag = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = FALSE AND id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE read_flag = TRUE AND created_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
